apps.name: Fretline

apps.localizedDescription:
Fretline is a native guitar tab player for iPad and iPhone (landscape).

• Opens Guitar Pro (.gp, .gpx, .gp5, .gp4, .gp3) and MusicXML files
• Plays the tab in sync with the YouTube video, with a tap-along sync editor
• Loop any bars, slow down from 25% to 150%, metronome and count-in
• Show, hide, mute or solo tracks; page or horizontal layout
• Built-in chromatic tuner
• Works offline, no account, no ads

Free and open source (GPL-3.0).

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Fretline uses the microphone for the built-in chromatic tuner.
